Short Compact Build.description:
💪 Build: Short Compact Build
Small frame packed with dense proportions — short limbs, a thick core, and a low center of gravity. Built close to the ground.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Short Compact Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Short compact frame — small stature with dense proportions, everything drawn inward and close. Limbs short relative to torso, low center of gravity. Female: shoulders narrow and close to the hips, short slim neck, small jaw, a small chest line above a short waist. Male: shoulders squared and close-set, short thick neck, blunt jaw, a flat chest on a compressed torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure drawn inward.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
